---
name: "Test Quality Review on PR (command)"
description: >-
  Re-reviews changed tests and parallelization configuration when a maintainer
  comments `/review-tests`. Grades new and modified test methods, audits
  cross-test parallel-safety, and posts one consolidated COMMENT review with
  apply-ready inline suggestions.

# The automatic on-open / on-synchronize variant lives in
# `test-reviewer-on-pr.agent.md`. They must remain separate workflows
# because mixing `slash_command` with other triggers makes gh-aw's
# activation gate always require a command position match, silently
# skipping the agent on every non-comment event.
on:
  slash_command:
    name: review-tests
    events: [pull_request_comment]
    strategy: centralized
  roles: [admin, maintainer, write]
  reaction: "eyes"

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  copilot-requests: write

imports:
  - shared/test-reviewer-shared.md

max-ai-credits: 2000

safe-outputs:
  messages:
    footer: "> 🤖 **Automated content by GitHub Copilot.** Generated by the [{workflow_name}]({agentic_workflow_url}) workflow.{ai_credits_suffix} · [◷]({history_link})"
  noop:
    report-as-issue: false

concurrency:
  # Centralized slash commands dispatch as workflow_dispatch. Resolve the PR
  # number from aw_context when github.event.issue.number is unavailable so
  # unrelated PR reviews do not share an empty concurrency group.
  group: test-quality-review-${{ github.event.issue.number || fromJSON(github.event.inputs.aw_context || github.event.client_payload.aw_context || '{}').item_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

timeout-minutes: 40
---

<!-- Body provided by shared/test-reviewer-shared.md -->
